comparison.objective: Support a partly open garage door, pull the emergency release, and lower the door under control.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load support, release actuation, and controlled lowering of a large articulated body; no fine coaxial impact work.
comparison.success_condition: Door is supported during release and lowered safely; the record omits quantitative force, speed, and final-pose limits.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is controlling a heavy load through a disengagement sequence, materially different from millimetre-scale fracture and recovery.
